text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short periods called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list known as the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe what a user needs from the product. Every day, team members meet briefly in standups to share progress and solve problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to test their work regularly, get feedback, and improve the product step by step. As a result, Agile helps teams respond quickly to changes and deliver value faster.
